name: cohesive zone model
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 用界面牵引与分离关系描述界面开裂、脱黏及损伤演化的模型。
scope_note: 内聚区模型亦称黏聚区模型；具体牵引—分离关系及参数由所采用的本构模型确定。
usage_overview: 用于板式轨道层间界面的损伤分析，以牵引—分离关系刻画黏结、软化至脱黏的过程，研究沉降、列车荷载或温度作用下的界面损伤及其与动力响应的联系。具体关系和参数取决于所采用的界面本构模型。

complete_examples.text: The fatigue damage constitutive models of the concrete slabs and viscoelastic filling layers, and the interfacial cohesive zone model, are set as the criteria to control and characterize the damage evolution of slab tracks.

The interfacial and fatigue damages of slab tracks, such as the filling layer, the track slab, and the track slab-filling layer interfaces, are constrained by the cohesive zone model (CZM) and fatigue damage constitutive relation respectively.
The soil settlement-induced track deformation is calculated by a practical iteration algorithm, where the nonlinear interfacial damage is simulated by the cohesive zone model.
The cohesive zone model (CZM) is one of the most popular methodologies to simulate the interfacial damage of track structures due to its convenience and practicality.
